name: endform
stderr:
Run your playwright tests in record time

Usage: endform [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  test            Run your playwright e2e tests
  login           Login to endform
  logout          Logout from endform
  whoami          Show your account and the organization this project uses
  analytics       Compare run counts, rates, and durations over time
  samples         Inspect concrete suite and test run executions
  quarantine      List, create, update, and deactivate quarantine rules
  test-attempt    Inspect a test attempt and link to its replay
  migrate-config  Migrate endform.jsonc/endform.json to endform.config.ts/js
  connect         Connect GitHub or Vercel to your Endform organization
  api-key         Manage organization API keys for running tests from CI
  live-test       Start or control an interactive live-test session
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --debug    Enable debug mode for verbose output
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
